profile_text.body:
The Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, which uses the name BAAI, is based in Beijing, China, and operates as a non-profit government laboratory. On its website the organization describes itself as a new type of research and development institution in the field of artificial intelligence. It says it brings together leading international AI scholars and focuses on core technology and original innovation.

BAAI states that its aim is to advance what it calls five source innovations: policy, academic thought, theoretical foundations, top talent, and the industrial ecosystem. No specific AI products, litigation, or other corporate filings are recorded for the organization.
